title: On trivial Jones--Vassiliev polynomials
summary: We develop a finite-type framework for studying the Jones polynomial and its ability to distinguish the unknot. The main difficulty is to propagate the vanishing of its finite-type coefficient layers from the natural upper degree bound down to the first potentially informative orders. To overcome this, we introduce a local clasped-twist construction whose diagrammatic reductions remain uniformly controlled even when the twist is made arbitrarily long.
